subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the red panda warrior monk Zhang Junjie from the character sheet in <Picture 1>, with reddish-brown hair braided into a high bun, amber eyes, white-and-dark-brown facial fur, round gold-and-jade bead earrings, a dark-green cross-collar robe with gold trim over a cream inner layer, dark-bronze shoulder and forearm armor with gold edging, a jade-disc belt buckle with red tassels, wide dark-navy trousers with cloud patterns, cream leg wrappings with green straps, and a dark-green gold-fitted scabbard holding a long sword with a jade pommel and red tassel; his energy is swirling jade-green mist.
<Subject 2> is the stout panda warrior monk on the far left of <Picture 2>, with a long braided beard, an ochre-yellow robe over brown armor and leather pauldrons, a red sash, two gourds hanging at his hip, a straw hat on his back, and a long wooden staff.
<Subject 3> is the slim panda boxer second from the left in <Picture 2>, with a topknot, a navy-blue embroidered cross-collar tunic with frog buttons, a cream sash, dark trousers, and metal-studded bracers.
<Subject 4> is the female red panda fighter third from the left in <Picture 2>, with a long auburn braid, a maroon vest over a cream shirt, a red sash, dark trousers with red-banded leg wraps, and studded bracers, fighting with a short blade.
<Subject 5> is the elderly grey-furred panda grandmaster on the far right of <Picture 2>, with a white beard, long white eyebrows, a topknot, a grey-blue vest over a grey shirt, a cream sash, and studded bracers, fighting with a horsetail whisk.
<Subject 6> is the mantis-like alien monster in <Picture 3>, with yellow-green chitin armor patched with turquoise-blue rust and rows of bone spikes, bulging orange-red compound eyes with slit pupils, long segmented antennae, huge spiked sickle forelimbs, clawed bird-like feet, and a ragged purple loincloth with a silver crescent emblem; it appears as a swarm of many identical individuals.
<Subject 7> is the divine crane Zhuhe Chijing in <Picture 4>, with a white body and long neck, a long red beak, a flame-like vermilion crest, crimson-to-orange flame-edged flight and tail feathers, red crest emblems on its wings, and long orange legs, its whole body wrapped in a glowing red-gold aura; it fights only on the ground at close range and never flies or breathes fire.

summary:
[reference generation] Continuing the fight in the bamboo forest, <Subject 1> breaks a three-way ambush of <Subject 6> with a 540-degree spinning kick, then cuts deeper into the swarm with Wing Chun trapping and sword-style footwork while <Subject 2>, <Subject 3>, <Subject 4>, and <Subject 5> struggle behind him. Green mist from his hits heals <Subject 3>, who strikes back. At the thickest point of the swarm, <Subject 1> summons <Subject 7>, which lands beside him as the second wave of monsters closes in.

detailed_description:
The target video is in a realistic live-action martial-arts style with a Chinese ink-wash texture, shot handheld on 35mm with fast push-ins and pull-outs, abrupt stops with slight rebound, and subtle lens breathing. The battlefield is a deep-mountain bamboo forest of towering ink-black bamboo with a winding bluestone path, moss-covered stones, reflective puddles, cracked ground, low-hanging mist, and floating bamboo-leaf fragments and ink particles. Every movement obeys real physics with clear force feedback and cause and effect; the green energy only accents the techniques and never hides them.
[Shot 1] A medium shot from a 15-degree low angle trucks laterally, following the arc of <Subject 1>'s spinning leg in the bamboo forest. Three <Subject 6> slide in at high speed from three directions and chop down with crossed sickle limbs. He side-steps, cuts the angle behind them, and uses the momentum of the turn to leap into a 540-degree horizontal spinning hook kick; his leg wind sweeps into a blade-shaped ring of green energy, and all three head plates shatter in the same frame, the monsters flying off in three directions. He lands with no wind-up and fires a low Wing Chun stop-kick that snaps one monster's supporting leg, then shifts with Taiyi sword-style footwork, cutting diagonally in a half-circle step into the thin edge of the swarm. A binding-hand wraps a sickle limb; he twists his body and drags the monster down, pins its bridge, and drives a darting finger strike through its red compound eye.
[Shot 2] At 00:06.500, the camera cuts to a near shot at a 90-degree side angle, pushing in fast on <Subject 3>. A wisp of green mist sweeps over his bruised shoulder and bracer-wrapped arm, and the bruises fade before our eyes. He bares his teeth with a roar and throws a swinging hook that blasts the pinning monster backward. Behind him, <Subject 2>, <Subject 4>, and <Subject 5> grit their teeth and follow <Subject 1> deeper into the swarm, still pressed hard by monsters on both flanks, as <Subject 1> fights and cuts his way forward ahead of them.
[Shot 3] At 00:10.000, the shot cuts to a medium close-up from a 45-degree side angle at eye level, the camera arcing around <Subject 1>'s upper body with small amplitude. At the densest point of the swarm, he plants his half-circle step and freezes. His right hand forms a hand seal and a crane's cry rings out. A burst of red-gold light strikes the ground, and <Subject 7> lands beside him with folded wings, head raised high, its talons gripping and cracking the bluestone, the flame-like red-gold feathers along its wing edges glowing. A wave of heat forces the front row of monsters to rear back together. Man and crane stand shoulder to shoulder as the second wave of <Subject 6> surges down from above and all sides.

overall_soundscape:
Bamboo leaves whip in the wind of the kick, followed by the simultaneous crack of three shattering head plates, sharp bone-snapping impacts, and sandals scraping across wet stone. The boxer roars, monsters hiss and clatter their sickle limbs, and the summoning ends with a piercing crane cry and a low roar of heat.

non_diegetic_music:
Fast Chinese war drums at a driving tempo with plucked guqin and low strings, cutting to a sustained brass swell as the crane lands.
